240-5295-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

360-1409-8160.description:

When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

1286-3899-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.

When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Kor Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kor Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4268-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

Gain life in any way.

Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.

When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2736-3967-5434-5555.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Peregrine Drake, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
When Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

328-2060-4017-4499.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Crystalline Crawler.
Your devotion to black is at least four, or you have at least two opponents.

Repeat.

171-1827-3258-5261.notablePrerequisites:
"Dragons" chosen with Palace Siege.

Resolve the copy of Vampiric Tutor, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting Beacon of Tomorrows on top of it, and causing you to lose 2 life.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Palace Siege triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
At the beginning of your draw step, you will draw Beacon of Tomorrows from the top of your library.
Repeat.

413-637-2452-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Archghoul of Thraben.
Mortuary and Archghoul of Thraben trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Archghoul of Thraben on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Archghoul of Thraben trigger, revealing Archghoul of Thraben from the top of your library and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Archghoul of Thraben by paying {0}.
Archghoul of Thraben enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2896-4846.description:
Cast Necromancy by paying {2}{B}.
Necromancy enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Necromancy.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Necromancy triggers, sacrificing Worldgorger Dragon.
Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, returning all permanents exiled by it to the battlefield.
Necromancy enters the battlefield, returning Worldgorger Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield attached with Necromancy.
Holding priority, activate all lands you control by tapping those, adding manas of any colors those lands can produce.
Repeat.
